author: lorenzo_pravata
seen: A Pixar-style 3D story about 70 seconds long. A lonely pink character sits by a door under the caption "2 YEARS AND NOBODY LOOKED AT THIS" and narrates ("I'm the one downstairs", "Then one winter", "And she decided I moved out") while a couple lives their life upstairs. It ends with the character wrapped in a blanket: "I'm COLD...". Every line has big centred captions; the product is the quiet answer to the story.
